items.information:
### 大会概要
この大会は[東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ(TSC)](https://cubing.nagoya/)が主催するWCA大会です。

#### 受付について
受付時間は9:00-9:40です。必ず受付時間内にお越しください。

### Overview
This competition is a WCA competition organized by [Tokai Speedcubing Community (TSC)](https://cubing.nagoya/).

#### About the reception
Reception hours are 9:00-9:40. Please be sure to arrive during the reception hours.

### FMC Asia 2025
同日の同会場にてFMC Asia 2025が開催されます。
FMC Asia 2025の開始時刻は本大会の終了後(3:00 PM)です。
本大会とFMC Asia 2025は両方出場できます。
FMC Asia 2025については以下のリンクから詳細をご確認ください。
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCAsia2025

FMC Asia 2025 will be held on the same day at the same venue.
FMC Asia start time is after the end of this competition (3:00PM).
You can participate in both this competition and FMC Asia 2025.
For more information about FMC Asia 2025, please click the link below.
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCAsia2025

items.information:

Because of the small competitor limit, every competitor MUST help throughout the day for the competition to stay on schedule. If you are finished competing we encourage you to stay until the end to help with running, judging, and scrambling the final few groups.

Note that the third rounds of 4x4 and 3x3 blindfolded are contingent upon 16 competitors participating in each of these events.

items.information:
**Welcome to FMC Asia 2025, the first FMC simultaneous competition in Asia since 2020!**

This competition will take place across multiple locations in Asia. Please pay close attention to the **date and time zone** of your location!
To view the full list of locations, please check the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCAsia2025#59379-locations).

The location adding period ended on July 11th at 23:59 UTC, and locations cannot be added under any circumstances.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
